Banner message

.dr-msg--banner · __banner · __title · __body · __actions · components/message.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

No orders yet

Your orders appear here, ready to re-book in a tap.

Browse services
  1. 1.dr-msg--bannerThe block: --card at 16, padding 16 / 16 / 32, gap 12, no shadow. The deeper floor is because the block ends on a button and the button needs its own air.
  2. 2.dr-msg__bannerThe art: 100% × 150 at the 13 media radius on the block's own --card ground, multiply blend, the image sized to 78% of the box's height and placed 16 from the top. aria-hidden. On the screen it is drones/drone-cargo-banner.jpg.
  3. 3.dr-msg__titleThe fact, 17/600, line 1.4.
  4. 4.dr-msg__bodyThe reason to come back, at body 14 / line 1.5 instead of the plain block's 13.
  5. 5.dr-msg__actionsThe one way out, 4 below the body instead of the plain block's 6.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Empty-state banner (.dr-msg--banner).

States

No state of its own: the art, title and body are read, not used. Its one way out takes the button states.

When to use

The banner message is the empty state that carries a picture: an illustrated top, the sentence, and one way out. It stands on one screen, order-history-empty. It is a message block with a render in place of the 52px mark, and it is the one decorative image in the product: the art is aria-hidden because it says nothing the sentence does not (WCAG 1.1.1). role="status" announces the state without taking focus (WCAG 4.1.3).

The copy is the empty-state tone from voice.md: No orders yet states the fact, ready to re-book in a tap is the reason to come back, Browse services is the exit. No apology, no cheer, no Oops.

Rule and anti-rule

Do

No orders yet

Your orders appear here, ready to re-book in a tap.

Browse services

A first-time empty screen: nothing has gone wrong, so the block can open with a picture of the service before the one action.

Don’t

Live tracking lost

We've lost the live signal from the operator's device. Your order is still active.

Try again

An error with a picture on top. In trouble the product is plain and accountable, and a drone render over a lost signal reads as decoration where the user needs the facts. Use the message block with the danger mark.
